Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone despite three nudges (c5113f4e, b7bfb4be, 866db028). Customer's reply (f690535f) is positive but passive -- "still getting used to the layout", no stated next step or urgency. Engaged and on Pro with 8 days left, so some chance, but no self-driven momentum yet.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Glad to hear things are going well, and that the layout is starting to click -- no complaints is a good sign this early.

One thing that usually makes the rest fall into place: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a quick 15 minutes this week help? I can walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything about the layout.

Best,
Priya
